tools.name: search_matches
tools.description: Find football matches that have a VoxBall verdict (man of the match voted by fans), by team, optional opponent and optional day. Accepts usual names and abbreviations (PSG, Barça, Man City). Returns match ids for get_match_verdict, most recent first. Only matches whose vote has closed are listed.

tools.name: get_match_verdict
tools.description: The VoxBall verdict of one match: who is the man of the match according to the fans who voted, with what qualifies it (number of voters, how many are VoxBall members, which club the other voting supporters follow, provisional or not, date), the top 10, and the number one of the press and of rating a

tools.name: get_season_ranking
tools.description: The VoxBall ranking of the best player of the season, all competitions: each match gives points to its top 10, from the fans' verdict when fans voted, otherwise from the press and rating algorithms. Returns the ranking with its electorate (voters, VoxBall members), whether the season is still in pro
